source_scope.selection: High-value natal rules with local context and canonical fact coverage.
excluded_existing_work: Deva Keralam Book I verses 2497–2498 pilot on PDF page 240 is excluded from new-work counts.

reviewer_method: Read page images and OCR together; resolve each local heading, ascendant, Nadiamsa identity and half; normalize only against the pinned Table 1; check sign/Navamsa/Nadi combinations for astronomical coexistence; approve natal clauses only when the current canonical fact ontology expresses every premise; retain timing, corrupt, disputed and inherited-ambiguous passages as explicit rejections.
